sc-render-smart-button="false" itemscope=""> <section class="article-container" data-stats-ve="35"><h1>Upgrade Gemini Notebook</h1><div class="article-content-container"><div class="cc"><div>You can upgrade Gemini Notebook to get additional capabilities, including higher limits and more features through <a href="https://one.google.com/about/ai-premium/"><u>Google AI Plans</u></a>, <a href="https://cloud.google.com/resources/notebooklm-enterprise?sjid=4840678451071865222-NC&amp;hl=en">Google Cloud</a>, or a qualifying <a href="https://support.google.com/gemininotebook/answer/16337734">Google Workspace plan</a>.</div>

<h2>Learn about higher limits and premium features&nbsp;in Google’s AI Plans</h2>

<div>
  <table class="borders">
    
      
      
      
      
      
    
    <tbody>
      <tr>
        <td>&nbsp;</td>
        <td>
        <p><strong>Gemini Notebook Standard&nbsp;</strong></p>
        </td>
        <td>
        <p><strong>Gemini Notebook in&nbsp;Plus&nbsp;</strong></p>
        </td>
        <td>
        <p><strong>Gemini Notebook in&nbsp;Pro&nbsp;</strong></p>
        </td>
        <td>
        <p><strong>Gemini Notebook in&nbsp;Ultra (20 TB Plan)</strong></p>
        </td>
        <td>
        <p><strong>Gemini Notebook in&nbsp;Ultra (30 TB Plan)</strong></p>
        </td>
      </tr>
      <tr>
        <td colspan="6">
        <p><strong>User Requirements</strong></p>
        </td>
      </tr>
      <tr>
        <td>
        <p><strong>How to Upgrade</strong></p>
        &nbsp;

        <p><span><em>Learn more about managing your plans with </em><a href="https://support.google.com/googleone/answer/9003633?sjid=13573268693365001414-NA"><em><u>G1</u></em></a><em> or </em><a href="https://support.google.com/a/answer/15095586?sjid=13573268693365001414-NA"><em><u>Workspace</u></em></a><em>.</em></span></p>
        </td>
        <td>
        <p>Sign up free of charge by using your gmail account.</p>

        <p><span>Or, <a href="https://support.google.com/gemininotebook/answer/16337734?hl=en&amp;ref_topic=16175214&amp;sjid=6383615620517546190-NA"><u>sign up with a qualifying Workspace or Workspace for Education&nbsp; license.</u></a></span></p>
        </td>
        <td>
        <p><span>Sign up for a <a href="https://one.google.com/ai?utm_source=notebooklm&amp;utm_medium=web&amp;utm_campaign=upgrade_page"><u>Google AI Plus</u></a> plan.</span></p>
        </td>
        <td>
        <p><span>Sign up for a <a href="https://one.google.com/ai?utm_source=notebooklm&amp;utm_medium=web&amp;utm_campaign=upgrade_page"><u>Google AI Pro</u></a> plan.</span></p>

        <p><span>Or, <a href="https://support.google.com/gemininotebook/answer/16337734?hl=en&amp;ref_topic=16175214&amp;sjid=6383615620517546190-NA"><u>sign up with a qualifying Workspace or Workspace for Education license.</u></a></span></p>
        </td>
        <td colspan="2" rowspan="1">
        <p><span>Sign up for a <a href="https://one.google.com/ai?utm_source=notebooklm&amp;utm_medium=web&amp;utm_campaign=upgrade_page"><u>Google AI Ultra</u></a> plan.</span></p>

        <p><span>Or, <a href="https://support.google.com/gemininotebook/answer/16337734?hl=en&amp;ref_topic=16175214&amp;sjid=6383615620517546190-NA"><u>sign up with a qualifying Workspace or Workspace for Education license.</u></a></span></p>
        </td>
      </tr>
      <tr>
        <td>
        <p><strong>Supported countries &amp; regions</strong></p>
        </td>
        <td>
        <div class="no-margin">Gemini Notebook is available in browser to all users above the age of consent (or&nbsp;<a href="https://support.google.com/accounts/answer/1350409?sjid=12486508145488360696-NA"><u>applicable in your country</u></a>) in <a href="/gemininotebook/answer/16164461#notebooklmcountries" rel="noopener">supported countries &amp; territories</a>.</div>

        <p><span></span></p>

        <p><span><a href="https://support.google.com/gemininotebook/answer/16296687?sjid=15971369145674768503-NA#Supportedcountriesandterritories">Learn more about supported countries &amp; territories for the Gemini Notebook mobile app</a>.</span></p>
        </td>
        <td>
        <p><span>Gemini Notebook is available in browsers with Plus access in the regions where <a href="https://support.google.com/googleone/answer/16548195?hl=en#zippy="><u>Google AI Plus is available</u></a>.</span></p>

        <p><span><a href="https://support.google.com/gemininotebook/answer/16296687?sjid=15971369145674768503-NA#Supportedcountriesandterritories">Learn more about supported countries &amp; territories for the Gemini Notebook mobile app</a>.</span></p>
        </td>
        <td>
        <p><span>Gemini Notebook is available in browsers with Pro access in the regions where <a href="https://support.google.com/googleone/answer/16476811?hl=en#zippy=%2Clist-of-countries-where-google-ai-pro-is-supported%2Clist-of-countries-regions-where-google-ai-pro-is-supported"><u>Google AI Pro is available</u></a>.</span></p>

        <p><span><a href="https://support.google.com/gemininotebook/answer/16296687?sjid=15971369145674768503-NA#Supportedcountriesandterritories">Learn more about supported countries &amp; territories for the Gemini Notebook mobile app</a>.</span></p>
        </td>
        <td colspan="2" rowspan="1">
        <p><span>Gemini Notebook is available in browsers with Ultra access in the regions where <a href="https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/16275805?hl=en#ultra_countries&amp;zippy=%2Cwhere-google-ai-pro-google-ai-ultra-are-available"><u>Google AI Ultra is available</u></a>.</span></p>

        <p><span><a href="https://support.google.com/gemininotebook/answer/16296687?sjid=15971369145674768503-NA#Supportedcountriesandterritories">Learn more about supported countries &amp; territories for the Gemini Notebook mobile app</a>.</span></p>
        </td>
      </tr>

        </td>

      <tr>
        <td>
        <p><strong>Data Handling</strong></p>
        </td>
        <td colspan="5" rowspan="1">
        <p>&nbsp;</p>

        <div class="no-margin"><p>Your data is protected, and is not used to train Gemini Notebook unless you provide feedback.&nbsp;When you share feedback to help us improve, we may review the full context of that interaction, including your queries, uploads, and the model’s responses.&nbsp;<a href="https://support.google.com/gemininotebook/answer/16179536"><u>Learn more.</u></a></p>

<p>To ensure safety and reliability, we may process your data to prevent fraud, abuse, and technical issues.&nbsp;</p>
</div>

        <p><span><br>
          <strong>Google Workspace or Google Workspace for Education users.</strong> Your uploads, queries and the model's responses in Gemini Notebook will not be reviewed by human reviewers even when you provide thumbs up or down feedback, and will not be used to train AI models.</span></p>
        </td>
      </tr>
      <tr>
        <td colspan="6">
        <ul>
          <li><em>Sharing a notebook does not change the source limit for any collaborator.</em></li>
          <li><em>Daily quotas are reset after 24 hours; monthly quotas are reset after 30 days.</em></li>
          <li><em>Some users may see a report, flashcards, infographic, slide deck, audio overview, or a video overview created automatically, when sources are first added to a notebook. These are generated once and do not contribute to limits.</em></li>
          <li><em>To confirm if you're using Gemini Notebook with upgraded plans, check to see if you have a distinct badge next to your user profile image in the user interface.</em></li>
        </ul>
        </td>
      </tr>
    </tbody>
  </table>

<h2>Upgrading via Google Cloud</h2>

<div>
  <table class="borders nice-table">
    <tbody>
      <tr>
        <td>&nbsp;</td>
        <td>
        <p><strong>Gemini Notebook for enterprise through Google Cloud</strong></p>
        </td>
      </tr>
      <tr>
        <td colspan="2">
        <p><strong>User requirements</strong></p>
        </td>
      </tr>
      <tr>
        <td>
        <p><strong>Plan or license requirement</strong></p>
        </td>
        <td>
        <p>You can use Gemini Notebook if your Cloud administrator has given you access to the following plan:</p>

        <ul>
          <li>Gemini Notebook for Enterprise</li>
          <li>Gemini Enterprise Standard</li>
          <li>Gemini Enterprise Plus</li>
          <li>Gemini Enterprise Frontline</li>
        </ul>
        <a href="https://cloud.google.com/resources/notebooklm-enterprise">Learn about Gemini Notebook for enterprise</a>.</td>
      </tr>
      <tr>
        <td colspan="2">
        <p><strong>Features &amp; availability</strong></p>
        </td>
      </tr>
      <tr>
        <td><strong>Higher Limits</strong></td>
        <td>
        <p>5X or more notebook artifacts, including Audio Overviews, Video Overviews, Reports, and more. Sharing a notebook does not change limits for any collaborator.</p>
        </td>
      </tr>
      <tr>
        <td>
        <p><strong>Premium features</strong></p>
        </td>
        <td>
        <p>Advanced Sharing</p>

        <p>Additional privacy and security features like VPC-SC, IAM controls, and enterprise-grade data protection.</p>
        </td>
      </tr>
      <tr>
        <td>
        <p><strong>Supported countries &amp; languages</strong></p>
        </td>
        <td>
        <p>Gemini Notebook is available in browser to all users above the age of consent (or&nbsp;<a href="https://support.google.com/accounts/answer/1350409?sjid=12486508145488360696-NA"><u>applicable in your country</u></a>) in <a href="/gemininotebook/answer/16164461#notebooklmcountries" rel="noopener">supported countries &amp; territories</a>.</p>
        <a href="https://support.google.com/gemininotebook/answer/16296687?sjid=15971369145674768503-NA#Supportedcountriesandterritories">Learn more about supported countries &amp; territories for the Gemini Notebook mobile app</a>.</td>
      </tr>
      <tr>
        <td colspan="2">
        <p><strong>Applicable Terms of Services &amp; data handling</strong></p>
        </td>
      </tr>
      <tr>
        <td>
        <p><strong>Applicable Terms of Service</strong></p>
        </td>
        <td><a href="https://cloud.google.com/terms">Google Cloud Platform/ SecOps Terms of Service</a></td>
      </tr>
      <tr>
        <td>
        <p><strong>Data protections &amp; how your data may be used</strong></p>
        </td>
        <td>
        <p><strong>Enterprise grade data protection:&nbsp;</strong></p>

        <h5>Our <a href="https://cloud.google.com/terms/cloud-privacy-notice"><u>Privacy Policy</u></a> describes how Google Cloud handles your data when you interact with Gemini Notebook.</h5>

        <p>Your uploaded files will remain within your GCP project. Data regionalization is honored.</p>

        <p>Additionally all files, chats and model outputs won’t be reviewed by human reviewers or used to improve generative AI models.</p>
        </td>
      </tr>
    </tbody>
  </table>
</div>

<h2>Upgrading via Google Workspace plan</h2>

<p>Expanded access may be available to qualifying workspace editions. <a href="https://support.google.com/gemininotebook/answer/16337734" rel="noopener">Learn more about using Gemini Notebook with a work or school Google account</a>.</p>

<div class="no-margin"><h2>Will my generations contain a watermark?</h2>

<ul>
  <li>All outputs generated in Gemini Notebook using Veo, Omni, or Nano Banana include invisible SynthID watermarks. SynthID identifies AI-generated content by embedding digital watermarks directly into AI-generated content.</li>
  <li>To further help you identify AI-generated content, a visible watermark is added to generated images and videos. Eligible users with Google One AI Pro and Ultra subscriptions can control this with the “Visible watermarking” toggle in the drop-down menu under your profile picture. A visible watermark will be applied automatically if you reside in India, South Korea, or Vietnam.</li>
</ul>
</div>
